detail.longDescription: I have Docker installed on a server, mostly used to run Jupyterlab images. We have 20 users interacting with 28 containers for developement and a few daily processes. One container runs Airflow, one runs Portainer. Very simple and basic. I suspect that Airflow, which instantiates many containers through DAGs, may cause the following issue : Docker's overlay2 folder contains 690 folders, and requires over 400GB space. Our server is saturated. How can I prune this folder?
